$comment: Per-TASK Pencil component sync registry. Tracks the provenance of each COMP (and its variants) inside the TASK's .pen file: was it copied from the canonical .sdlc/conventions/design-system.pen, or created locally for this TASK? Used by sdlc-pencil-sync.sh to (a) detect drift between TASK copies and DS source, (b) propagate DS changes into all TASKs that copied a given component. Pencil MCP does NOT support cross-file component reference (per Pencil schema docs: 'You cannot reference components across files. If you want to use a component from a different file you must copy it over'), so we maintain this provenance manifest to enable explicit, auditable propagation.
_taskId_doc: Owning TASK. Must equal parent dir name. Verified by sdlc-pencil-sync.sh.

designSystemRef.lockedAt: {ISO when this TASK booted from DS}

_designSystemRef_doc: Snapshot of the DS state when this TASK was started. drifted=true means DS has bumped version since lockedVersion. sync.sh --check reports the diff.
_components_doc: Map of {pencilNodeId in TASK.pen} → {compId, source, sourceCompId?, sourceVersion?, customizations?[]}. Created/updated by UIUX agent during TASK work. source enum: 'design-system' | 'local'. sourceCompId only present when source=design-system (the original COMP-NNN in DS). customizations is an audit trail of overrides applied to a copied DS component (so propagate can re-apply them after re-copy).
_promotedToDS_doc: When a local COMP gets RFC-approved and promoted into design-system.pen, append an entry here so we don't double-propagate. Schema: {compId, promotedAt, dsVersion, byTask, rfcRef}.
_drift_doc: Updated by sdlc-pencil-sync.sh --check. outdated = TASK has older sourceVersion than DS now. missing = TASK references a COMP-ID DS no longer has. extra = TASK has a source=design-system COMP that DS never defined (corruption indicator).
